summary: Queries a buffer descriptor: if the capacity/validity field this+0x4 is greater than zero, writes the buffer data pointer (this+0x0) into output a2 and the stored size (this+0x8) into output a3, returning 1. Otherwise zeroes both outputs and returns 0. Used by memory-copy, decompression and struct-parse paths.

operations.description: The query succeeds only while the capacity/validity field this+0x4 is greater than zero.
On success, writes the buffer data pointer at this+0x0 into the output parameter a2.
On success, writes the stored size at this+0x8 into the output parameter a3.
Returns 1 to signal that the buffer descriptor was valid and outputs were populated.
On failure, zeroes both output parameters a2 and a3.
Returns 0 to signal that the buffer descriptor was invalid.
Consumed by StructuredMemoryCopyWithHeaderPrepend, BoundedMemoryCopyWithSizeValidation, sub_587120, DecompressionDecode and StructInitParse as the buffer validity/query helper.
